responsibility: Implements translation from resolved Rust TyTy types to GCC type trees. It lowers function signatures, ADTs, tuples, arrays, slices, strings, references, pointers, closures, dynamic trait objects, built-in scalar types, and placeholder/projection resolutions; constructs special record layouts for enums, slices, str, closure environments, and trait objects; canonicalizes named types through the compile context; and supplies helper logic such as the implicit enumeral node type and recursion-guarded parameter resolution.
same_name_distinction: Implements the full TyTy-to-GCC type translation logic. Unlike rust-compile-type.h, it contains the concrete construction of backend trees and layouts for Rust types, including special records for enums, slices, str, closures, and dynamic trait objects, plus canonicalization and recursion handling.
